fusions.name: Quarry Named
fusions.desc: A thrown spear that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: End of the Chase
fusions.desc: A finishing strike that deals 16 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Scent Taken
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
